title: Octavia E. Butler Landing 360° Photosphere
caption: NASA Perseverance's historic first 360-degree cylindrical panorama, stitched from 142 individual high-resolution exposures on Sol 3. Shows the distant northern rim of Jezero Crater, rocky ripples, and the initial touchdown site on Mars.

hotspots.name: Jezero Crater North Rim
hotspots.desc: Ancient crater wall rising 600m above the floor

hotspots.name: Perseverance Touchdown Mark
hotspots.desc: Sky Crane retro-rocket scour zone

hotspots.name: Delta Scarp Horizon
hotspots.desc: River delta deposit fans 2.1 km to the west

title: Van Zyl Overlook & Séítah 360° Photosphere
caption: Spectacular 360° Navcam and Mastcam-Z panorama captured from Van Zyl Overlook overlooking the rugged Séítah olivine cumulate unit where the rover was stationed during Ingenuity Mars Helicopter flight trials. Features layered sedimentary strata and basaltic sand dunes.

hotspots.name: Wright Brothers Airfield
hotspots.desc: Flat landing zone where Ingenuity made the first powered flight on another planet

hotspots.name: Séítah Olivine Strata
hotspots.desc: Ancient igneous cumulate outcrop altered by liquid groundwater

title: Delta Front Solar Waystation Vista
instrument: Mastcam-Z Dual Imager & Navcam Sol 44 Survey
caption: Wide panoramic vista facing the base of the Jezero western delta fan. Demonstrates the flat terrain chosen for the autonomous solar & micro-reactor charging waystation at the junction between the crater floor and river delta.

hotspots.name: Solar Array Foundation
hotspots.desc: Flat deltaic mudstone pavement ideal for solar power generation

hotspots.name: Western Delta Scarp
hotspots.desc: Stratified cliffs ascending toward delta top

title: Three Forks Mars Sample Depot Ground View
caption: Authentic high-resolution Mastcam-Z and Navcam panorama looking across the flat, drop-zone terrain of Three Forks where NASA's Perseverance cached 10 titanium sample tubes as a backup repository for the Mars Sample Return campaign.

hotspots.name: Sample Depot Cache Zone
hotspots.desc: Surveyed drop locations for hermetically sealed titanium sample cores

hotspots.name: Delta River Inflow Channel
hotspots.desc: Ancient fluvial channel cutting into crater floor

title: Mount Kodiak Ancient Delta Remnant
caption: High-definition view of Kodiak Butte, an isolated erosional remnant of the western delta fan. The steep inclined strata (foreset beds) sandwiched between horizontal layers are conclusive proof of an ancient river feeding a standing lake on Mars.

hotspots.name: Delta Topset Beds
hotspots.desc: Horizontal gravel sheets from late-stage fluvial flow

hotspots.name: Steep Foreset Delta Front
hotspots.desc: Sediments dumped rapidly at river mouth into standing lake

title: Hawksbill Gap & Wildcat Ridge Astrobiology Outcrop
caption: Ultra high-resolution panorama of the Hawksbill Gap and Wildcat Ridge sedimentary outcrop. Rich in hydrated smectite clays (4-7% H2O) suitable for water harvesting and preservation of potential ancient Martian biosignatures.

hotspots.name: Hydrated Clay Strata
hotspots.desc: Fine-grained lacustrine mudstone rich in phyllosilicates

hotspots.name: Wildcat Ridge Core Hole
hotspots.desc: Target drill abrasion where aromatics were detected

title: Belva Crater Impact Basin Rim Vista
caption: Panoramic mosaic looking inside the 0.9-kilometer-wide Belva impact crater. Craters act as natural geologic cuts, exposing steep dipping beds that reveal ancient Martian mega-floods and lake currents.

hotspots.name: Belva Dipping Beds
hotspots.desc: Steep downward-angled sedimentary layers from ancient river bars

hotspots.name: Impact Breccia Wall
hotspots.desc: Shocked rock clasts and melt sheets from meteoritic impact

title: Belva Ridge Power & O2 Relay Rim Drive
caption: Perseverance's expansive view traversing along the northern ridge drive toward the Belva Relay Station. High ground provides reliable line-of-sight for power transmission and communications relays across the crater.

hotspots.name: Relay Tower Vantage
hotspots.desc: Elevated ridge post ensuring continuous orbital comms link

hotspots.name: Crater Rim Traverse Trail
hotspots.desc: Stable bedrock pathway bypassing loose sand drifts

title: Neretva Vallis River Channel & Bright Angel Outflow
caption: Perseverance's survey of 'Crocodile Bridge' and the ancient channel bed of Neretva Vallis, an ancient river system that breached the western rim of Jezero Crater and carved deep gorges with bright carbonate and silica outcrops.

hotspots.name: Crocodile Bridge Bedrock
hotspots.desc: Hydrated silica bedrock polished by catastrophic fluvial discharge

hotspots.name: Inflow Gorge Canyon
hotspots.desc: Rim breach where river torrent entered Jezero lake

title: Jezero Western Rim Lookout Ridge Summit Vista
caption: Breathtaking panoramic rim view captured at +634 meters above the crater floor. Unfolds the entire expanse of Jezero Crater, from the western rim peaks across the river delta to the landing site over 20 kilometers away.

hotspots.name: Crater Floor Vista
hotspots.desc: Full crater panorama extending 45 kilometers to eastern rim

hotspots.name: High-Ground Comms Mast
hotspots.desc: Emergency shelter post with unobstructed orbital coverage

title: Enchanted Lake Basal Delta Mudstone
caption: High-resolution surface survey of finely laminated lacustrine mudstone and clay shale at the foot of the delta scarp looking toward distant crater rims.

title: Jezero Northern Rim Wall Escarpment
caption: Traverse viewpoint looking up at the 600m sheer impact crater rim wall and ancient Noachian crustal megabreccia overlooking the crater floor.

title: Sedona Crater Impact Cavity Bedrock Panorama
caption: Authentic high-resolution panoramic vista across fractured crater floor olivine-basalt bedrock and basaltic sand ripples at the Sedona Crater impact perimeter.

title: Hartwell Crater Ejecta & Eastern Traverse Panorama
caption: Authentic Sol 59 full-color panoramic vista of the eastern traverse facing the continuous ejecta blanket and raised rim of Hartwell Crater.
